metadata.question: Did Sacramento, California experience 2-meter air temperatures above 110 degrees fahrenheit in September 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need to find temperature data for Sacramento, CA in September 2022. Will use ERA5-Land hourly data which has 2-meter air temperature. 2. Masking strategy: No masking needed - this is meteorological reanalysis data, not satellite imagery with clouds. 3. Logic: Need to convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit and check if any pixel/time exceeds 110°F. Valid zero would be "no temperatures above 110°F" (answer B). C3 would be if calculation returns None/NaN. C1 if no data exists for that period. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions sacramento = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.4944, 38.5816]) start_date = '2022-09-01' end_date = '2022-09-30' # 2. Data Acquisition - ERA5-Land hourly 2m temperature collection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filterBounds(sacramento) \ .select('temperature_2m') # Check collection size col_size = collection.size().getInfo() print(f"Images found: {col_size}") if col_size == 0: print("No ERA5-Land data for September 2022.") print("C1") else: # 3. Get maximum temperature across all times in September 2022 max_temp_image = collection.max() # 4. Extract temperature at Sacramento location temp_k = max_temp_image.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.max(), geometry=sacramento, scale=11132, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('temperature_2m').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Conversion if temp_k is None: print("Temperature calculation returned None.") print("C3") else: # Convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit temp_f = (temp_k - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32 print(f"Max temperature in September 2022: {temp_f:.2f} F ({temp_k:.2f} K)") # Check if temperature is in valid range if temp_f < -50 or temp_f > 150: print("Temperature outside valid range.") print("C3") elif temp_f > 110: print(f"Temperature exceeded 110 F (reached {temp_f:.2f} F)") print("A") else: print(f"Temperature did not exceed 110 F (max was {temp_f:.2f} F)") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
sacramento = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.4944, 38.5816])
start_date = '2022-09-01'
end_date = '2022-09-30'

# 2. Data Acquisition - ERA5-Land hourly 2m temperature
collection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(sacramento) \
    .select('temperature_2m')

# Check collection size
col_size = collection.size().getInfo()
print(f"Images found: {col_size}")

if col_size == 0:
    print("No ERA5-Land data for September 2022.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Get maximum temperature across all times in September 2022
    max_temp_image = collection.max()
    
    # 4. Extract temperature at Sacramento location
    temp_k = max_temp_image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.max(),
        geometry=sacramento,
        scale=11132,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('temperature_2m').getInfo()
    
    # 5. Validation & Conversion
    if temp_k is None:
        print("Temperature calculation returned None.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit
        temp_f = (temp_k - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32
        
        print(f"Max temperature in September 2022: {temp_f:.2f} F ({temp_k:.2f} K)")
        
        # Check if temperature is in valid range
        if temp_f < -50 or temp_f > 150:
            print("Temperature outside valid range.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif temp_f > 110:
            print(f"Temperature exceeded 110 F (reached {temp_f:.2f} F)")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"Temperature did not exceed 110 F (max was {temp_f:.2f} F)")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
